# FLX-5032: histogram bins do not partition the declared range

**Family:** numerics (the 5000 band)

SEAM-FIDELITY-SPEC §2: bins are strictly increasing and partition the declared range. The first edge is the column's declared minimum and the last its declared maximum; otherwise a record could fall outside every bin and the two sides' bin counts would not account for the same records.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-5032
```
